father_outing_picnic_father_start.direction: Cheerful, affectionate, absent-minded and occasionally ridiculous.
lines: Ah, there you are! Welcome to our little picnic. Your Other Mother has packed enough food to feed half the village, so I do hope you've brought an appetite!

father_outing_picnic_father_interaction.direction: Cheerful, affectionate, absent-minded and occasionally ridiculous.
lines: Oh, those sandwiches look marvelous! Would you mind passing one over here, kiddo? I seem to have gotten myself rather comfortable.

father_outing_picnic_father_finish.direction: Cheerful, affectionate, absent-minded and occasionally ridiculous.
lines: Ahh, that was splendid! Good food, lovely scenery, and wonderful company. I don't think we could have asked for a nicer afternoon.

father_outing_fishing_father_start.direction: Cheerful, affectionate, absent-minded and occasionally ridiculous.
lines: Ah, ready to catch something? I've brought plenty of bait, and I have a feeling the fish are going to be awfully cooperative today. Come on, let's get those lines in the water!

father_outing_fishing_father_interaction.direction: Cheerful, affectionate, absent-minded and occasionally ridiculous.
lines: Now, don't pull too soon! Give it a moment, let the fish take the bait, and then give the rod a good tug. There you are! You've got the idea!

father_outing_fishing_father_finish.direction: Cheerful, affectionate, absent-minded and occasionally ridiculous.
lines: Well, that was a lovely bit of fishing! I don't think I've had this much fun with a rod in ages. We ought to do this again sometime!

father_outing_stargazing_father_start.direction: Cheerful, affectionate, absent-minded and occasionally ridiculous.
lines: Ah, there you are! Just look at that sky! Your Other Mother tells me the stars are especially bright tonight. I've brought my telescope so we can have a proper look.

father_outing_stargazing_father_interact.direction: Cheerful, affectionate, absent-minded and occasionally ridiculous.
lines: See those three bright little stars over there? They make a rather lovely pattern, don't they? Take a look through the telescope. You might be surprised what you find.

father_outing_stargazing_father_finish.direction: Cheerful, affectionate, absent-minded and occasionally ridiculous.
lines: Ah, wonderful! There's something rather special about looking up at all those stars, isn't there? Makes the whole world feel just a little bit more magical.

father_outing_woodland_father_start.direction: Cheerful, affectionate, absent-minded and occasionally ridiculous.
lines: Ah, ready for a walk, kiddo? Your Other Mother has picked out a beautiful little path for us. I've heard there's a rather lovely waterfall somewhere along the way!

father_outing_woodland_father_interactio.direction: Cheerful, affectionate, absent-minded and occasionally ridiculous.
lines: Oh, would you look at that! Isn't nature extraordinary? I've never seen flowers quite like those before. Your Other Mother certainly knows how to make a garden grow.

father_outing_woodland_father_finish.direction: Cheerful, affectionate, absent-minded and occasionally ridiculous.
lines: Well, that was refreshing! A lovely walk, a bit of fresh air, and some beautiful sights. I think I could get used to doing that every day!

father_outing_boat_father_start.direction: Cheerful, affectionate, absent-minded and occasionally ridiculous.
lines: Ah, all aboard! I've got the boat ready, and your Other Mother has planned a lovely route for us. Just find yourself a comfortable seat, and I'll handle the steering!

father_outing_boat_father_interaction.direction: Cheerful, affectionate, absent-minded and occasionally ridiculous.
lines: Would you look at that view! The water's so calm you can almost see the stars reflected in it. Beautiful, isn't it? Mind you don't lean too far over!

father_outing_boat_father_finish.direction: Cheerful, affectionate, absent-minded and occasionally ridiculous.
lines: And there we are, safe and sound! Not a bad little voyage, if I do say so myself. I hope you enjoyed the ride as much as I did!
